# Lumina Furniture

> Pakistan's largest premium furniture e-commerce store offering factory-direct pricing, custom-made furniture, and nationwide delivery across all major cities.

## Products

- [All Furniture](https://luminafurniture.pk/?view=products): Browse the complete collection of premium bedroom, living room, dining room, and office furniture. Factory direct pricing with no middlemen.
- [Bedroom Furniture](https://luminafurniture.pk/?view=products&category=bedroom): Premium beds, wardrobes, dressers, and bedside tables. Custom sizes available.
- [Living Room Furniture](https://luminafurniture.pk/?view=products&category=living-room): Sofas, coffee tables, TV units, and accent chairs. Handcrafted with premium materials.
- [Dining Room Furniture](https://luminafurniture.pk/?view=products&category=dining): Dining tables and chair sets for 4 to 12 persons. Custom dimensions available.
- [Office Furniture](https://luminafurniture.pk/?view=products&category=office): Ergonomic desks, executive chairs, and storage solutions for home and corporate offices.

## Services

- [Custom Furniture](https://luminafurniture.pk/): Bespoke furniture manufactured to your exact dimensions, material choice, and finish. Request a quote online.
- [Nationwide Delivery](https://luminafurniture.pk/): Safe and timely delivery to Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, and all major cities in Pakistan.
- [White Glove Assembly](https://luminafurniture.pk/): Professional furniture assembly service available in select cities.

## About

- [About Lumina Furniture](https://luminafurniture.pk/): Lumina is Pakistan's premier furniture brand combining factory-direct pricing with premium craftsmanship. Materials are sourced globally and crafted locally.

## Key Facts

- Business Type: E-commerce furniture store (FurnitureStore)
- Country: Pakistan
- Currency: Pakistani Rupee (PKR / Rs.)
- Specialties: Bedroom furniture, living room furniture, dining furniture, office furniture, custom furniture
- Key features: Factory direct pricing, custom sizes, nationwide delivery, white glove assembly
- Return policy: 14-day returns on standard items; custom orders are non-refundable
- Standard delivery: 5–7 business days
